A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe SAGA and contain corresponding text, equations, figures, tables and references. Neither supplied PDF includes appendices or the supplementary material cited in the text; comparison is reliable for the supplied content.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection and source-attribution experiments on DeMamba and DVF, including numerical comparisons, ablations and representation analyses in Tables 2–7 and Figures 4–6.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and their numerical and qualitative results.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.2 retain the frozen vision encoder, spatial/temporal transformer, two-stage training, combined cross-entropy and hard-negative-mining objective, and T-Sig extraction procedure.

E1.justification: Both use DeMamba with 19 synthetic generators and DVF with eight generators. The five attribution levels and cross-generator and cross-dataset scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 5 retains exactly the same comparator membership within both the DeMamba and DVF comparisons. The training-strategy and loss comparisons in Tables 2, 3, 6 and 7 also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the 80/20 in-domain split, 10/9-generator held-out evaluation, other generator-group splits, and DeMamba-to-DVF protocol. Training-data fractions, training regimes and reported evaluation metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: The loss and training-regime ablations, t-SNE visualizations, T-Sig analyses and unseen-generator analyses are retained unchanged. Both also contain the same brief account of sample-count sensitivity, referring further details to unavailable supplementary material.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The numerical entries and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 5 retains SAGA accuracies of 99.94% on DeMamba and 95.39% on DVF; Table 7 retains 94.99% for two-stage GEN-L attribution with 0.5% source-labeled data.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 and the accompanying triplet-loss, negative-selection, gradient and margin reasoning are unchanged. No mathematical definition, assumption or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about five-level attribution, data efficiency using 0.5% source-labeled data, generalization and T-Sig interpretability.

C2.justification: Both give the same explanations of HNM-driven separation, generator-specific temporal patterns and potential open-set applicability. No substantive interpretation, applicability qualification or limitation is added.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page URL to the abstract, providing a new resource-access pointer. No additional implementation settings, hardware information or reproducibility instructions appear; the linked site's contents cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: Both retain the same 61 cited works and the same positioning relative to image attribution and earlier video attribution. Changes to author-name phrasing and reference page back-links are editorial.

P1.justification: v2 updates affiliations, adds contact information, a CVPR 2026 publication note and funding acknowledgements, explains the '-L' suffix, and makes small wording corrections. The section sequence and substantive narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 moves Table 1 between columns, revises table shading and reflows text. Figure 2 changes 'TASi' to 'T-Sig', and its caption redirects a reference from Section 3 to supplementary Section S-1. All six figures and seven tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity and discoverability by correcting Figure 2's terminology, explaining '-L' and adding a project-page pointer. The scientific methods, evidence and conclusions remain unchanged, and the referenced supplementary material is still absent from both supplied PDFs.
